entities.summary: Miloš Koterec is a career diplomat from Slovakia. He was sent to the Permanent Mission of Slovakia to the U.N. from '95–'99. He then went on to work at the Permanent Mission to NATO for Slovakia in 2001. In 2005 he was elected as an MEP for Slovakia. Miloš Koterec was a political leaders from Partizánske (b. 1962-10-11, Partizánske). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.

entities.summary: Miloš Koterec is a career diplomat from Slovakia. He was sent to the Permanent Mission of Slovakia to the U.N. from '95–'99. He then went on to work at the Permanent Mission to NATO for Slovakia in 2001. In 2005 he was elected as an MEP for Slovakia. Miloš Koterec was a political leaders from Partizánske (b. 1962-10-11, Partizánske). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
